upgrade.title: Upgrade Safe
upgrade.intro: Upgrading deploys a new safe on the latest contract, clones this safe's signer groups, policies, and rekeyed-address registry onto it, and then — via a governed rekey proposal — hands every controlled address (including this safe's own account) over to the new deployment. Funds never leave the addresses.
upgrade.step1: Deploy & clone the configuration (signed by your wallet, no custody change).
upgrade.step2: Propose the migration rekey; admins approve it at the group threshold.
upgrade.step3: Execute — the new safe takes over, and this safe becomes read-only history.
upgrade.savedHint: Saved to this browser's safe list. Now create the migration rekey proposal and collect admin approvals.

registry.title: Rekeyed Addresses
registry.description: External addresses whose spending authority has been rekeyed to this safe. The list is governed by admin proposals and is used during migration to re-rekey every controlled address to the new safe. Registering an address here does not rekey it — submit the actual rekey transaction from that account separately.
registry.addressHint: The account rekeyed (or about to be rekeyed) to this safe.
